scientific_integrity: The proof exhausts the three possible \(p\)-adic valuations of any solution \(n\mid p^2(p+1)\). The unique mixed case reduces to \(p+1=d^2\), forcing \(p=3\). The finite verifier is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only fibers containing prime squares. It does not settle whether \(B(n)=n(\sigma(n)-n)\) has infinitely many collisions, and it makes no claim for arbitrary higher prime powers.
title: Prime-square fibers of the proper-divisor product
